text:
Predicates:
Flies(x, y) ::: x flies to airport y.
Departure(x, y) ::: x departs from airport y.
Arrival(x, y) ::: x arrives at airport y.
Premises:
Flies(susan, LGA) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
∀x (Departure(x, y) ∧ Arrival(x, y) → ¬(x = y)) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
Flies(john, LGA) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
¬Flies(john, LGA) ::: John flies to LGA airport.
